global: This miso ramen features a rich, amber broth with tender pork and crisp menma. Topped with shredded green onions, it sits in a white bowl with red patterns, set against a bright red background under even lighting.

regions.background: The tray is light beige, smooth, rectangular with rounded corners, and slightly textured surface.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with red geometric pattern and blue characters, smooth glossy surface, slightly raised rim.
regions.soup: Miso ramen broth with noodles, rich brown color, glossy surface, visible strands and chunks, topped with shredded green onions.
regions.spoon: White ceramic spoon with smooth, slightly glossy surface, curved bowl, and faint red pattern near handle.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear as golden-brown, sliced, slightly curved pieces with glossy, tender-looking surfaces.
